Bit late here but are you you sure the version of libglut you have installed is exactly libglut.so.3 ?

Whenever I've been given that error it's because an oldish program is making a call for something that's been upgraded by the Linux upgrade system to a different version. For example; if the latest Mint is using libglut.so.3.1 then the program will expect to find the exact library libglut.so.3

I've solved this with other programs by finding the original library from somewhere like here: http://packages.ubuntu.com/precise/amd64/freeglut3/filelist and installing the older one.
